jp: 一枚岩を掘り抜いた洞窟か――。{n}この岩塊全体に通路が張り巡らされて{n}いるようだな

en: A shadow rose from the darkness of the{n}cave. The man, soaked from head to toe,{n}was someone they had met before.

jp: ？　何故その名前を？　おぬし、{n}それがしを知っているのでござるか!?

en: The shadow user Bol Gil Bol seemed not to{n}remember clearly the battle just after he{n}woke on the Dragon Ship. He had been{n}tormented only by the fear and dread of{n}being hunted, and by the time he calmed{n}down, he had crossed so many shadows at{n}random that he did not even know where{n}he had fled from.

jp: その後、峡谷付近を彷徨い歩くうち、{n}突然流れてきた水に呑まれ、影を渡り{n}ながら破壊された鬼哭関跡を抜け、{n}ほうほうのていでこの場所まで辿り{n}着いたという。
en: After that, he said, while wandering near{n}the gorge, he was swallowed by a sudden{n}flood, and crossed from shadow to{n}shadow through the ruins of the{n}shattered Ogre Wail Gate, barely reaching{n}this place alive.

jp: 竜船での遭遇の状況を聞くに及び、{n}ボルは非礼を詫び、同行を申し出た。{n}おぼろげながら闘いの記憶が蘇り、{n}Ｄ・Ｓたちが命を奪わぬよう手加減{n}していたことを悟った様子だった。
en: Upon hearing how they had met on the{n}Dragon Ship, Bol apologized for his{n}rudeness and offered to travel with them.{n}A hazy memory of the battle had{n}returned, and he seemed to realize that{n}D.S. and the others had held back so as{n}not to kill him.

jp: 今はかように濡れネズミの情けない{n}姿でござるが、それがし、必ずお役に{n}立ってみせるでござる。何卒、ご恩を{n}返す機会をくだされ！
en: Now this one is a wretched sight, a drowned{n}rat as you see, but this one shall surely{n}prove useful, forsooth. Please, good sirs,{n}grant this one a chance to repay your{page}kindness!

jp: そーゆー暑苦しーのは苦手なんだよ。{n}ついてきたきゃ勝手にしろい。オメエ{n}以外はたいがいそんなヤツばっかだぜ

jp: 来る者は拒まずってコト

jp: かたじけない！
en: This one is obliged, forsooth!

jp: 巨大岩塊の中心と思しき、大きな広間{n}だった。見上げても天井は見通せず、{n}ただ暗い竪穴が遥か上まで続いている。

jp: これは……!?

en: Perhaps under interference from the{n}World-Breaker Gate, the air shook in{n}slowly shifting waves, and the shaft{n}leading up echoed them with a strange{n}tone, like an instrument out of tune.

en: When D.S. formed the seal, the crystals{n}everywhere responded, and power{n}returned to the transporter.

jp: シーラ、待ってろ！

jp: 引き返してるヒマはなさそうだ
